title: Mid-infrared supercontinuum generation in fluoride fibers: a comparative study
task: Mid-infrared supercontinuum generation in fluoride fibers
key_results: Octave-spanning spectrum 1600–5350 nm with 140 mW output power; flat near-zero anomalous dispersion with tight mode confinement produces smooth spectrum versus steep anomalous dispersion causing soliton fission
comments: Excellent experimental validation against generalized nonlinear Schrödinger simulations; fiber dispersion profile is key design lever for spectral shape, though power scaling remains modest for some applications.

model_io.model: Generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation simulation + three fluoride fiber variants

hypotheses.hypothesis: High steep anomalous dispersion triggers soliton fission and spectral modulation; flat near-zero anomalous dispersion with tight confinement enables smooth supercontinuum

title: Combinatorial mutagenesis of N-terminal sequences reveals expanded stability determinants of the Escherichia coli N-degron pathway
task: Identify N-terminal sequence determinants of protein stability in E. coli N-degron pathway
key_results: P2 residue identity contributes comparably to P1 in determining stability; identified novel destabilizing motifs with P1 Cys paired with bulky/negatively charged P2-P5 residues; machine learning predictions correlate quantitatively with ClpS binding energies
comments: Comprehensive saturation mutagenesis provides unprecedented mechanistic detail, though the correlation between predicted stability and actual ClpS binding suggests data-driven models capture biophysical principles not fully captured by canonical degron rules.
